response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_gb, g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remaining_gb / m.mean_avg AS remaining_ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The CPU–GPU usage gap is the signed difference proccpu - procgpu, averaged per group. Rows where either value is missing are left out of that average.
The ratio divides each group's average remaining storage by the unweighted mean of all groups' averages, with each group counting once. It is not the mean over individual rows.
An inner join to sites keeps only processing records whose site exists. A group whose remaining-storage values are all missing still appears, with a NULL ratio that sorts last.

alternatives.interpretation: The gap is the absolute difference between CPU and GPU usage, ABS(proccpu - procgpu).
